conf.description: Tenable Security Center /rest/system/logs REST pull: console/API/audit trail. No Elastic tenable_sc data stream covers this; message is free text so source.ip/event.action/event.outcome are regexed out per the work order's own recommendation. Direct route, no guard hop.

conf.comment: tenable-nessus / system-log / api-pull. Hand-built: no Elastic data stream for the SC audit log, and who/from-where/success-or-failure live only inside the free-text message field.

functions.description: record why a custom regex pipeline is needed
mine client IP, auth type and success/failure out of the free-text login message; other module messages simply do not match and leave these fields absent

default event.outcome to unknown when no verdict was found in message (per recommendation), local INFO/WARNING/CRITICAL -> 0/1/2 severity lookup distinct from the vulnerability dataset's reversed 0-4 scale, normalize date (epoch seconds or RFC-2822 string) into _time since @timestamp cannot be targeted directly
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
